newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary O/N rates rebound to close at 22.625 pct.
newsitem.headline: Hungary O/N rates rebound to close at 22.625 pct.

text.p: Hungarian overnight interest rates rose more than four percent on Friday and were seen settling around the one-week reverse repo rate, currently at 22.50 percent.
"It was a quiet morning with normal money supply and no signs of massive speculation," said Zoltan Kalman of Hypo-Bank Hungaria.
Overnight rates closed at 22.625 percent, rising sharply form Thursday's close of 18 percent, dealers said.
The end-of-month basement levels, sometimes as low as 17.5 percent were not particularly due to Monday's 0.25 percentage points repo rate cuts by the central bank, dealers said.
They see a better than even chance for another cut of similar size before the end of the year.
